changelog.summary: Fixes CMS-authored posts never appearing publicly: the editor published the native catalog entry with status 'draft', so categories/tags merged while every public list filtered the post out. The editor now uses an explicit draft/pending-approval/pending-confirmation/published/partial/failed/ambiguous state machine, publishes with status 'published', and reports a verified but search-index-pending post as partial instead of success. Also adds first-class qortal:// links, https copy-with-badge behaviour, full-text search with a versioned qms-cms-search-index@1 (CMS and imports), footer/header attribution fixes, and a durable completion-notification module.

desktop.changelog: Wizard/plan/UX baseline from 0.8.0-alpha.5 plus the bundled CMS 0.8.0-alpha.4 fixes: CMS-authored posts publish publicly, qortal:// and https link behaviour, full-text search index and UI, footer attribution and header branding. Desktop sources are otherwise unchanged.

publisher.changelog: Unchanged in this release; the Publisher artifact is byte-identical to 0.8.0-alpha.2.

cms.changelog: CMS 0.8.0-alpha.4: publish state machine and status fix (CMS posts now appear in Posts/Latest/detail/terms after verified publication); first-class qortal:// links accepted by the editor and sanitizer and opened through Hub OPEN_NEW_TAB; https links copy with a transient badge; live full-text search over a versioned qms-cms-search-index@1 with Unicode and phrase support; 'Qortal Migration Studio CMS' footer attribution without QDN-name labels; hardcoded 'Qortal QDN publication' eyebrow removed.
